# The walks through babykev

Each walk is a set of pages. **Read the tutorial** explains each change, with the code to look at. **Build it yourself** gives every command to run and every change to make by hand. A narrative has the first alone.

- **babykev, shown one move at a time**. [Read the tutorial](tutorial/read.md), [Build it yourself](tutorial/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/).
- **babykev, the first lecture**. [Read the tutorial](narrative/read.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/narrative/).

- **The formatter, the linter and the type checker of babykev**. [Read the tutorial](linting/read.md), [Build it yourself](linting/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/linting/).
- **The documentation of babykev**. [Read the tutorial](docs/read.md), [Build it yourself](docs/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/docs/).
- **just, the recipes of babykev**. [Read the tutorial](just/read.md), [Build it yourself](just/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/just/).
- **The model of babykev, explained**. [Read the tutorial](model/read.md), [Build it yourself](model/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/model/).
- **The tests of babykev**. [Read the tutorial](testing/read.md), [Build it yourself](testing/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/testing/).
- **The contract of babykev**. [Read the tutorial](contract/read.md), [Build it yourself](contract/build.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/contract/).
- **babykev, the lecture**. [Read the tutorial](lecture/read.md). [Its website](https://rahuldave.github.io/babykev-walk/lecture/).
